description: Provision a Google Cloud Servicedirectory ServiceDirectoryService via Config Connector. Fields mirror the servicedirectory.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ServiceDirectoryService spec.

namespaceRef.description: The ServiceDirectoryNamespace that this service belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ServiceDirectoryNamespace resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/namespaces/{{namespaceID}}".

name.description: The name of a ServiceDirectoryNamespace resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ServiceDirectoryNamespace resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The serviceId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Servicedirectory ServiceDirectoryService
